::: {.home-lead}
**dofjson** is the client for SIDOF, the JSON open-data service of Mexico's
official gazette (DOF, *Diario Oficial de la Federación*), with a fallback
onto the DOF's own website for the days SIDOF loses. It is also the reader of
the `notas-archivo` release: the compact record of every legal provision ever
published.
:::

A DOF *nota* is a legal provision, and the DOF is the official source of legal
text. SIDOF (`sidof.segob.gob.mx`) is the Secretaría de Gobernación's system
for the gazette; its JSON endpoints are undocumented, and it reports a day it
has lost as `200 OK` with empty lists, exactly as it reports a Sunday.
`dofjson.get_nota` and `dofjson.get_notas` try SIDOF first and fall back to
`www.dof.gob.mx` on their own, so a caller never needs to know which source
answered: the `fuente` field of every result says. The package writes no
dataset of its own, and `nota2md` reaches the DOF through it.

::: {.fronts}
::: {.front}
### One entry point

Every function is reachable off `dofjson`: SIDOF first, the DOF website for
the days SIDOF loses.
:::
::: {.front}
### A resumable archive

`dofjson --archivo` downloads one JSON per day since 1917, and picks up where
it stopped when interrupted.
:::
::: {.front}
### Every title since 1917

`legal_provisions_titles` streams the `codNota`, title and date of every legal
provision from the `notas-archivo` release, cached locally.
:::
:::

## Quickstart

```bash
pip install dofjson
```

```bash
dofjson 2026-07-16 --endpoint notas --outdir output
dofjson --pdf-edicion 16-06-2026 --edicion VES --outdir output
dofjson --archivo --desde 1980-01-01 --hasta 1980-12-31
```

```python
import dofjson

dofjson.get_nota(4997808)               # SIDOF has it, or the website does
dofjson.get_notas(dt.date(1999, 3, 8))  # a day SIDOF lost, recovered from the website
dofjson.download_nota_pdf(4997808, outdir)
```

See [Install](pages/install.qmd) for what the package needs,
[Command line](pages/cli.qmd) and [Python](pages/python.qmd) for the two ways
to query the gazette, [Archive](pages/archive.qmd) for the whole-history
downloader and the days SIDOF loses, and [Titles](pages/titles.qmd) for the
`notas-archivo` release. Extending the package itself is documented
separately, on the
[developer docs](https://legistlan.github.io/dofjson/dev/).
